edits.new: For each child alternative, identify the parent alternatives and permitted topic connections that could cover it. A condition is required only within the alternative it restricts; it need not constrain other alternatives. For each potential covering alternative, test every applicable condition independently by changing or removing it while preserving the child's defining kind or activity and all its other restrictions. Establishing one condition does not establish another. Failing one alternative does not establish exclusion from the parent.
edits.old: For every child alternative, identify a kind or activity the parent covers that could cover it. Test every applicable parent condition independently. Attempt to change or remove each condition while preserving the child's defining kind or activity and all its other restrictions. Establishing one condition does not establish another.

edits.new: Stop when a valid counterexample establishes failure of full coverage. Otherwise, establish coverage through at least one parent alternative or permitted topic connection for every child alternative. If admission, exclusion or necessary coverage cannot be settled, leave the answer unresolved.
edits.old: Stop when a valid counterexample establishes failure of full coverage. Otherwise, establish every applicable parent condition across every child alternative before approving full coverage. If admission, exclusion or necessary coverage cannot be settled, leave the answer unresolved.

edits.new: split each parent alternative into its independently required conditions
edits.old: split a compound parent phrase into independently required conditions

edits.new: Record one open-ended counterexample question per direction: "Which case admitted by [child] falls outside [parent] while failing [one quoted condition] of [parent alternative]?" Name both nodes and specify the alternative being tested. A condition of one alternative need not constrain another. Construct a concrete candidate satisfying the whole child meaning, preserving every child requirement. Check the selected condition and exclusion from every other parent alternative and permitted topic connection. Give a counterexample only if none covers it. Otherwise, explain the candidate's failure and establish the remaining coverage, or use null if admission or exclusion remains unresolved. A failed candidate alone does not prove full coverage.
edits.old: Record one open-ended counterexample question per direction: "Which case admitted by [the proposed child] violates [one independently required parent condition]?" Name the child and quote the single parent condition being tested. Do not ask a yes/no question about the child failing the parent's complete definition. Construct a concrete candidate that changes only that condition, then check it against the whole child meaning and every permitted parent connection. In the answer, give a valid counterexample, explain why the candidate contradicts a child requirement and establish the remaining coverage conditions, or use null if admission or exclusion remains unresolved. The question does not presume that a counterexample exists. A failed candidate alone does not prove full coverage.
